_about: Public-domain Francis Aidan Gasquet (1846-1929, Benedictine historian, later cardinal) for the Word Hoard: Henry VIII and the English Monasteries (2 vols, 1888-1889), Edward VI and the Book of Common Prayer with Edmund Bishop (1890), The Great Pestilence (1893), The Old English Bible (1897), The Eve of the Reformation (1900), English Monastic Life (1904) and Parish Life in Mediaeval England (1906), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
